_readme: Transcriptions of the parts of passed ordinances the product applies ahead of codification (WS1 M4b). Each was read from the Clerk's scanned PDF (no text layer) in a Claude Code session on 2026-10-21 and approved by Jack in the M4b PR. Labeled data, not model output at runtime. tests/test_applied_law.py pins the code to this file; once the code text carries the change, the same test pins the code to the code text instead.
